text:
alexk: eu-west1 autoscaler is not adding nodes during a big spike — ~250 pods Pending with reason '0/12 nodes available: Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu'. Nothing scaled for the last 8 minutes. Anyone else seeing this?

infra-bot: [ALERT] k8s-autoscaler eu-west1: scale_up_failed (threshold breached) — alert_id=AUTOSCALE-9876 : https://pm.redwood/integrations/alerts/AUTOSCALE-9876

morgan: can you paste autoscaler logs and nodepool config? Could be quota, or CA stuck in thrash/backoff.

alexk: here are the immediate outputs — pods stuck:
```
$ kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep Pending | wc -l
250
$ kubectl describe pod inference-worker-abc -n inference
Events:
  Type     Reason            Age   From               Message
  ----     ------            ----  ----               -------
  Warning  FailedScheduling  5m    default-scheduler  0/12 nodes are available: 12 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu
```
And CA logs (tail):
```
I0315 12:09:01 autoscaler.go:345] Scale-up request: need 6 nodes, evaluating zones
I0315 12:09:05 cloudprovider.go:210] API quota check: GPU quota available: 0 in zone europe-west1-b
I0315 12:09:05 autoscaler.go:402] Scale-up failed: insufficient quota or no capacity in zone
I0315 12:10:30 autoscaler.go:512] Backoff: waiting 120s before next attempt
```

jinp: looks like GPU quota exhausted in the zone (or cloud has no spare GPUs). If we try to spin up different machine types it'll still hit quota. We should: 1) manually increase nodepool to add a few preemptible nodes in another zone, 2) temporarily shift traffic to us-central1 while we recover.

tara: agree. Also bump the autoscaler max nodes for the affected pool and increase the stabilization window to avoid thrash. Disable scale-to-zero for the pool for the next 30 minutes.

oncall: I'm on it. Manually increasing nodepool size by +10 (preemptible g4dn) in europe-west1-c now. Running: 
```
gcloud container node-pools resize redwood-gpu-pool --cluster=prod-eu-west1 --zone=europe-west1-c --num-nodes=18 --project=redwood-prod
```

infra-bot: [INFO] Resize request submitted to GKE — operation op-3b9f (link: https://console.cloud.google.com/kubernetes/operation/op-3b9f)

priya: careful with costs — preemptibles are fine for burst but keep an eye on sustained usage. Also we need to shift traffic by region policy rather than full DNS failover. Use smart routing: degrade eu-west1 weight to 25% -> us-central1 75%.

morgan: grabbing autoscaler config — we had scaleDownUnneededTime=5m and stabilizationWindowSeconds=0. Suggest changing stabilizationWindowSeconds=300 and add scaleUpCooldown to 120s. Also set minReplicaCount for the HF jobs.

alexk: applied a temporary routing change in the router:
```
POST /api/v1/route-weight
{
  "service": "inference-api",
  "weights": {"eu-west1": 25, "us-central1": 75},
  "note": "emergency traffic shift due to eu-west1 GPU capacity"
}
```

oncall: GKE resize completed, new nodes coming up. A few pods scheduled to new nodes, still seeing some OOMs on startup but overall scheduling improved.

infra-bot: [METRICS] GPU allocation in eu-west1 now at 92% — pod pending count down to 47. Latency p90 on inference-api increased from 120ms -> 320ms during shift.

priya: good. Please open an incident ticket + follow-up: add quota check to autoscaler preflight, pre-warm nodepool during business hours, add runbook for region shift. We should also add a fallback model variant without GPUs for a tiny fraction.

morgan: created INC-7832: "eu-west1 autoscaler quota/capacity failure during spike" — triage + postmortem requested. Link: https://tracker.redwood/INC-7832

tara: action items for postmortem: (1) autoscaler preflight GPU quota check (2) increase stabilization window and add cooldowns (3) implement cross-region slow-roll routing (4) alert when pending pods > 50 for > 3m with autoscaler backoff state. Assigning owners in INC-7832.

alexk: thanks all — scaling looks stable now, traffic shift smoothing latency. Will follow up in INC-7832 with exact times and costs. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: [RESOLVE] AUTOSCALE-9876 auto-resolved at 12:49 UTC after manual intervention and routing adjustment.

morgan: quick notes for follow-up PR: update terraform module for nodepool to include a warm-min (min_surplus_nodes) and a quota check step in CI before upgrades.

priya: also add a cost run for 24h of preemptible extra nodes to estimate bill impact and present to finance.

oncall: logging this thread into INC-7832 and closing the immediate alert. Monitoring will keep the routing in place for 1 hour and then ramp eu-west1 back up if stable.

alexk: closing on my side. Will add debug logs to the autoscaler collector to capture quota responses more verbosely next time.

---
Follow-ups: INC-7832 created, owner=morgan, due=72h, postmortem scheduled.
